decisionContext.lockedTarget: Factors beyond agents' control eliminate moral responsibility in the basic-desert sense.

route.description: Show that luck and factors beyond the agent's control defeat the sourcehood needed for basic-desert responsibility while leaving forward-looking responses available.
route.successCriteria: The route succeeds if agents are shown not to be appropriate sources for basic desert and safety, rehabilitation, or rule enforcement can replace retributive blame and punishment.

bridges.description: Basic-desert moral responsibility and retributive blame or punishment are unwarranted, even if independently justified forward-looking responses remain.
Who agents are and what they do result from luck or factors beyond their control, so they lack the appropriate sourcehood for basic desert.
Reasons-responsive distinctions, sanctions, safety restrictions, rehabilitation, and rule enforcement can be retained on non-desert forward-looking grounds.
Adding physical indeterminacy does not let the agent settle which outcome occurs and therefore cannot rescue basic-desert control.

decisionContext.lockedTarget: Relevant alternative ability consists in self-control, absence of disabling interference, and action for reasons.

route.description: Establish that reasons-responsive self-control, rather than causal independence, supplies free will worth wanting and warrants responsibility practices.
route.successCriteria: The route succeeds if adequate reasons-responsive self-control is shown compatible with causal determination and is connected to justified everyday responsibility, blame, or punishment.

bridges.description: Agents with adequate self-control can justifiably bear moral responsibility and proportionate blame or punishment despite determination or luck.
Reasons-responsive self-maintaining control and moral competence are real capacities that causal determination alone does not remove.
Public non-draconian rules and sanctions make responsibility practices socially functional while excusing agents whose impairments defeat control.
Practical agency needs neither libertarian sourcehood nor quantum randomness, because useful unpredictability and control are available under determination.
